purpose: Prove that a fresh chat can recover exact continuation-critical Python source bytes from GitHub, verify their SHA-256 before execution, and fail closed on source identity errors.

sources.reason: Fresh-chat test validates exact source-byte recoverability only; scientific execution remains controlled by the migration preregistration and equivalence gates.

positive_tests: Fetch both sources from GitHub without using prior runtime files.
Decode/read exact source bytes and require byte count and SHA-256 for both.
Execute only the canary and require exact stdout SHA-256.
Confirm the G30 replacement source is recoverable byte-for-byte but do not execute M1_MID.
negative_tests: Mutate one byte of the canary in memory and require source SHA mismatch before execution.
Use an intentionally wrong expected SHA and require fail-closed.
Request an intentionally nonexistent source path and require fail-closed without substituting a similarly named file.
pass_condition: All positive and negative tests pass in a fresh runtime. Persist QROS_RUNNER_SOURCE_DURABILITY_CROSS_CHAT_PASS_v1.json. Do not modify scientific HEAD.
failure_condition: Any inability to recover exact source bytes, any SHA mismatch, execution before source verification, or silent source substitution fails the test.
